CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AllMonsWillObey.fr: Tous les POKéMON obéiront à tes\nordres !

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AttackStatFlash.en: The ATTACK stat of all your\nPOKéMON increases a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nFLASH outside of battle.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AttackStatFlash.fr: L'ATTAQUE de tous tes POKéMON est\naugmentée.\pIl permet aussi d'utiliser la CS\nFLASH hors des combats.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_BadgesHaveAmazi.en: Only skilled TRAINERS can collect\nPOKéMON BADGES.\pI see you have at least one.\pThose BADGES have amazing secrets,\ndid you know?
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_BadgesHaveAmazi.fr: Les BADGES sont portés par des\nDRESSEURS de haut niveau.\pMmm… Tu en as au moins un.\pCes BADGES ont d'étranges pouvoirs\n!

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ComeVisitAnytim.en: Come visit me anytime you wish.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ComeVisitAnytim.fr: Reviens me voir quand tu veux.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DefenseStatSurf.en: The DEFENSE stat of all your\nPOKéMON increases a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nSURF outside of battle.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DefenseStatSurf.fr: La DÉFENSE de tous tes POKéMON sera\naugmentée.\pTu pourras aussi utiliser la CS\nSURF hors des combats.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DescribeWhichBa.en: Now then…\pWhich of the eight BADGES should\nI describe?
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DescribeWhichBa.fr: Alors…\pLequel des huit BADGES je dois\nte décrire ?

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv30Cut.en:
POKéMON up to Lv. 30 will obey
you.\pThat includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.\pPOKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.\pIt also lets you use the move
CUT outside of battle.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv30Cut.fr:
Les POKéMON d'un niveau inférieur à
30 t'obéiront.\pCela comprend aussi les POKéMON
obtenus pendant un échange.\pS'ils sont d'un niveau supérieur,
ils seront incontrôlables !\pTu pourras aussi utiliser la CS
COUPE hors des combats.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv50Strengt.en:
POKéMON up to Lv. 50 will obey
you.\pThat includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.\pPOKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.\pIt also lets you use the move
STRENGTH outside of battle.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv50Strengt.fr:
Les POKéMON jusqu'au niveau 50
t'obéiront.\pCela comprend aussi les POKéMON
obtenus pendant un échange.\pCeux d'un niveau supérieur seront
incontrôlables !\pTu pourras aussi utiliser la CS
FORCE hors des combats.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv70RockSma.en:
POKéMON up to Lv. 70 will obey
you.\pThat includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.\pPOKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.\pIt also lets you use the move
ROCK SMASH outside of battle.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv70RockSma.fr:
Les POKéMON de niveau 70 ou moins
t'obéiront.\pCela comprend aussi les POKéMON
obtenus pendant un échange.\pS'ils sont d'un niveau supérieur,
ils seront incontrôlables !\pTu pourras aussi utiliser la CS
ÉCLATE-ROC hors des combats.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SpStatsWaterfal.en: The SP. ATK and SP. DEF stats of\nall your POKéMON rise a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nWATERFALL outside of battle.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SpStatsWaterfal.fr: Les stats des ATQ. SPÉ. et DÉF.\nSPÉ. augmentent un peu.\pTu pourras aussi utiliser CASCADE\nhors des combats.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SpeedStatFly.en: The SPEED stat of all your\nPOKéMON increases a little bit.\pIt also lets you use the move\nFLY outside of battle.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SpeedStatFly.fr: La VITESSE de tous tes POKéMON sera\nun peu augmentée.\pTu pourras aussi utiliser la CS VOL\nhors des combats.
